verdict.rationale: Opting out of analytics or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a government online-services portal like TWC's UTR/UTS applications, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only registration, tax filing and general services, with nothing on telemetry, cookies or tracking controls. The probes show only missing llms.txt and OpenAPI files and a blocked robots.txt, none of which bear on tracking opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
